title: 第10章 魂力提升，再打一架吧
slug: 斗罗冬儿重生我不是唐舞桐
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

霍雨浩抬起手，轻轻地伸出食指。

一道冰蓝色的光芒飞出，朝着马小桃射去。

马小桃感受到致命危机，身后的魂环疯狂亮起，释放出火焰全力抵挡蓝色光线。

寒冰与火焰的对撞造成恐怖的气压，王冬儿和萧萧直接被震晕了。

马小桃身上的火焰消失，整个人身上结了一层冰霜，坠入下方的海神湖中。

“咦，还有人。”

天梦冰蚕将力量收回，霍雨浩整个人也倒在地上。

当王冬儿再次醒来时，发现霍雨浩正躺在自己的身上。

她正想摸一摸霍雨浩的头，霍雨浩就醒了过来。

他们起身，看到一个白衣中年人站在他们的身旁。

对方平静地对他们说道：“刚刚你们看到的东西不允许泄露出去，学校会给你们进行补偿。但如果你们把消息泄露出去，就会被开除。自己好好想一想吧。”

白衣男子将三个瓶子丢给他们，随后就头也不回的离开了。

“消息传出就开除，这家伙也未免太霸道了些。”王冬儿吐槽道。

“王冬，你没事吧？”霍雨浩担心地问。

“放心吧，我没事，不过萧萧还没醒。”

霍雨浩检查一下萧萧的情况，发现她只是睡着了。

王冬儿直接捏了一下萧萧的脸：“快起来了，别睡了。”

萧萧坐起来，摸着自己的脸：“好疼啊，是谁捏我？”

“是他！”王冬儿甩锅霍雨浩。

“刚刚那个是什么东西呀？”

“你就当是遇到了一颗大火球吧。刚刚有老师来警告我们，今天遇到的事情一定要记得保密。”

“行吧，放心，我不会把你们两个的事情说出去的。”萧萧偷笑。

王冬儿有些无语：“我是说是大火球的事情。”

“对了，这个给你。”

王冬儿把小瓶子丢给萧萧。

“这又是什么呀？”萧萧

“这应该是升魂丹。”

“升魂丹是什么？和玄水丹差不多吗？”霍雨浩问道。

“差不多吧，升魂丹可以用来提升魂力，对于你的作用很大。”

霍雨浩现在的魂力确实太低了一些。

Page (1/3)

Huo Yuhao raised his hand and gently extended his index finger.

A ray of ice blue light flew out and shot towards Ma Xiaotao.

Ma Xiaotao felt the fatal crisis, and the soul ring behind her lit up crazily, releasing flames to resist the blue light with all its strength.

The collision of ice and fire caused terrifying air pressure, and Wang Donger and Xiao Xiao were stunned.

The flames on Ma Xiaotao's body disappeared, her whole body was covered with a layer of frost, and she fell into the Poseidon Lake below.

"Hey, there's someone else."

Tianmeng Bingcan withdrew his power, and Huo Yuhao fell to the ground.

When Wang Donger woke up again, she found Huo Yuhao lying on her body.

She was about to touch Huo Yuhao's head when Huo Yuhao woke up.

They stood up and saw a middle-aged man in white standing beside them.

The other party said to them calmly: "What you just saw is not allowed to be leaked. The school will compensate you. But if you leak the news, you will be expelled. Think about it for yourself."

The man in white threw the three bottles to them and then left without looking back.

"Firing him as soon as the news comes out is too domineering." Wang Dong'er complained.

"Wang Dong, are you okay?" Huo Yuhao asked worriedly.

"Don't worry, I'm fine, but Xiao Xiao hasn't woken up yet."

Huo Yuhao checked Xiao Xiao's condition and found that she was just asleep.

Wang Donger pinched Xiao Xiao's face directly: "Get up soon, don't sleep."

Xiao Xiao sat up and touched his face: "It hurts so much. Who pinched me?"

"It's him!" Wang Dong'er blamed Huo Yuhao.

"What was that just now?"

"Just treat it as if you encountered a big fireball. A teacher just came to warn us that we must remember to keep everything we encounter today confidential."

"Okay, don't worry, I won't tell anything about you two." Xiao Xiao snickered.

Wang Donger was a little speechless: "I mean it's about the big fireball."

"By the way, this is for you."

Wang Donger threw the small bottle to Xiao Xiao.

"What is this?" Xiao Xiao

"This should be the soul-raising pill."

"What is the Soul Ascension Pill? Is it similar to the Xuanshui Pill?" Huo Yuhao asked.

"Absolutely. The Soul Ascension Pill can be used to increase your soul power, and it will be of great use to you."

Huo Yuhao's current soul power is indeed too low.
